## Maintainer-requested change

Describe the requested correction and link the relevant non-confidential issue.

## Evidence and scope

Identify affected sections and public sources. Distinguish design proposals
from observed implementation or test results.

## Publication checks

- [ ] This change was requested or agreed by the maintainer.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, customer information, or private references are included.
- [ ] I am entitled to submit the included material.
- [ ] No product readiness, performance, compliance, or licensing claim is introduced without evidence and maintainer direction.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md; this checkbox is not a separate assignment or license agreement.
